summary: API regression passed after fixing block-create MongoDB serialization; frontend login/dashboard load, but navigation to New Block crashes React.

ui_bugs.issue: React runtime overlay appears with 'destroy is not a function' when navigating from dashboard to New Block; form never loads.

integration_issues.issue: Unmount cleanup throws because an async axios Promise is returned directly from useEffect; subsequent route content is unavailable.

action_items: Change NewBlock and Slots useEffect callbacks to use a braced async function with no returned Promise; retest all route navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: Never return api.get(...).then(...) from React useEffect; React treats the Promise as cleanup and calls destroy on unmount.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_regression pending block was created by the API test; no cleanup endpoint was available.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend auth, dashboard, role restriction, create/duration/corridor, slots, and CSV export passed. Frontend login/dashboard passed; New Block navigation crashes before form render, so approval, slot action, mobile overflow, and full UI flow remain unverified.
rca of the issue: NewBlock has useEffect(()=>api.get('/meta',hdr).then(...),[]), which returns the axios Promise. React interprets the returned value as an effect cleanup function; on route unmount it invokes the Promise as destroy and throws TypeError: destroy is not a function. Slots has the same pattern and should be corrected proactively.
